_notes: Deathknell cluster named-rare + cave-boss loot (2026-10-22). One item drops per kill from the creature's pool. Numbers from the real loot formulas (tools/build_deathknell_content.py).

Mawgrin the Gaunt.name: Gaunt Fang Dirk
Mawgrin the Gaunt.flavor_text: Pulled from a mouth that never stopped being hungry.

Mawgrin the Gaunt.name: Stray-Hide Jerkin
Mawgrin the Gaunt.flavor_text: Mangy, patched, and still smells like wet dog and grave dirt.

Mawgrin the Gaunt.name: Mawgrin's Gnawed Collar
Mawgrin the Gaunt.flavor_text: Someone put this on him once. Someone regretted it.

Mawgrin the Gaunt.name: Plaguebitten Wristwraps
Mawgrin the Gaunt.flavor_text: Stained past all washing. The stains do not seem to mind.

Ossric the Unburied.name: Sexton's Grave-Spade
Ossric the Unburied.flavor_text: Heavy iron, still crusted. It has dug more than one hole twice.

Ossric the Unburied.name: Ossric's Burial Shroud
Ossric the Unburied.flavor_text: Linen that was never meant to be worn by anyone still moving.

Ossric the Unburied.name: Wightbone Bracers
Ossric the Unburied.flavor_text: Shaped from something that used to hold a sword.

Ossric the Unburied.name: Rattling Skull Charm
Ossric the Unburied.flavor_text: It rattles when the grave wind rises. Lately, that is always.

Goldfang.name: Goldvein Staff
Goldfang.flavor_text: A prospector's staff, veined with something that glints and bites.

Goldfang.name: Spiderglass Wand
Goldfang.flavor_text: Hardened silk, brittle as glass. Handle with the tips of your fingers.

Goldfang.name: Gilded Silk Cord
Goldfang.flavor_text: Gold dust spun into the web. The spider kept the best strands.

Goldfang.name: Webstrand Gloves
Goldfang.flavor_text: Sticky for the first hour. After that, you stop noticing.

Mourning Wren.name: Wren's Tear-Stained Veil
Mourning Wren.flavor_text: Damp at all times. It was never dry even before the pond.

Mourning Wren.name: Keening Wand
Mourning Wren.flavor_text: Hold it to your ear and you will hear someone calling a name.

Mourning Wren.name: Pond-Reed Sandals
Mourning Wren.flavor_text: Woven reeds, soft with age. They leave no tracks at the water's edge.

Mourning Wren.name: Drowned Locket Ring
Mourning Wren.flavor_text: The picture inside has long since washed out. The ring remembers it anyway.

Gaffer Thorne.name: Thorne's Rusted Scythe
Gaffer Thorne.flavor_text: A harvest tool, in a harvest that never ended.

Gaffer Thorne.name: Scarecrow-Straw Cloak
Gaffer Thorne.flavor_text: Itchy, and stuffed with something that is probably not just straw.

Gaffer Thorne.name: Burnt Farmer's Gauntlets
Gaffer Thorne.flavor_text: Scorched leather over scorched knuckles. They still grip hard.

Gaffer Thorne.name: Hearth-Ward Shield
Gaffer Thorne.flavor_text: A barn door, cut down and reinforced. It kept a family safe once.

Sergeant Halbrook.name: Halbrook's Halberd
Sergeant Halbrook.flavor_text: The Crusade's issue polearm, with notches along the haft for every tally.

Sergeant Halbrook.name: Scarlet Sergeant's Pauldrons
Sergeant Halbrook.flavor_text: Crimson enamel over dented plate. Someone polished them every day.

Sergeant Halbrook.name: Picket's Stout Boots
Sergeant Halbrook.flavor_text: Good for long watches and for kicking down doors.

Sergeant Halbrook.name: Crimson Tabard-Sash
Sergeant Halbrook.flavor_text: Faded red cloth. It still looks righteous at a distance.

Hatchery Warden Skrix.name: Skrix's Chitin Cap
Hatchery Warden Skrix.flavor_text: Chitin plates bound with silk. Light, strong, faintly twitching.

Hatchery Warden Skrix.name: Hatchery Silk Mantle
Hatchery Warden Skrix.flavor_text: Spun around a clutch that never hatched.

Hatchery Warden Skrix.name: Brood-Warden's Spur
Hatchery Warden Skrix.flavor_text: A leg-spur from something much larger. Still sharp enough to matter.

Hatchery Warden Skrix.name: Eggshell Buckler
Hatchery Warden Skrix.flavor_text: Hardened shell and silk. Surprisingly good at deflecting things.

The Pale Weaver.name: Weaver's Pale Leggings
The Pale Weaver.flavor_text: Fine silk, the colour of bone. It is a little too fine to be natural.

The Pale Weaver.name: Silkbound Gauntlets
The Pale Weaver.flavor_text: Chain and web, woven together by something patient.

The Pale Weaver.name: Pale Fang Wand
The Pale Weaver.flavor_text: A single curved fang, set in ivory-coloured wood.

The Pale Weaver.name: Cocooned Cloak
The Pale Weaver.flavor_text: Wrapped around something once. It kept the shape.

Broodmother Nesh'ka.name: Nesh'ka's Venom Dagger
Broodmother Nesh'ka.flavor_text: Still wet. Do not lick it, bro.

Broodmother Nesh'ka.name: Brood Mother's Silk Robe
Broodmother Nesh'ka.flavor_text: Pearly silk, warm to the touch. It hums faintly when something skitters nearby.

Broodmother Nesh'ka.name: Spiderfang Shortbow
Broodmother Nesh'ka.flavor_text: Strung with a single strand of her silk. It never frays.

Broodmother Nesh'ka.name: Carapace Bulwark
Broodmother Nesh'ka.flavor_text: A slab of her own shell, ground flat and strapped to a frame.

Broodmother Nesh'ka.name: Novice's Water-Stained Primer
Broodmother Nesh'ka.flavor_text: Someone has corrected the margins in a firmer hand than the text.
Broodmother Nesh'ka.label: Tome (Spi)

Valdric Bonewarden.name: Bonewarden's Maul
Valdric Bonewarden.flavor_text: Femurs, lashed to a pillar of the ossuary. It hits like a sermon.

Valdric Bonewarden.name: Ossuary Plate Girdle
Valdric Bonewarden.flavor_text: Welded from the plates of those who came to be buried.

Valdric Bonewarden.name: Skullkeeper's Cowl
Valdric Bonewarden.flavor_text: A hood stitched to a skull-cap. The skull is not decorative.

Valdric Bonewarden.name: Reliquary Bone Ring
Valdric Bonewarden.flavor_text: A vertebra, polished by centuries of nervous fingers.

Brother Wystan.name: Wystan's Censer Mace
Brother Wystan.flavor_text: The chain is the only part that is not scorched.

Brother Wystan.name: Penitent's Hood
Brother Wystan.flavor_text: Wool, cut for confession. It hides a great deal.

Brother Wystan.name: Scarlet Vigil Hauberk
Brother Wystan.flavor_text: Mail under crimson. It was blessed. The blessing is still mostly intact.

Brother Wystan.name: Brother's Rosary
Brother Wystan.flavor_text: Every bead is warm. The last one is a little too warm.

High Inquisitor Fairbanks.name: Fairbanks' Inquisitor Mace
High Inquisitor Fairbanks.flavor_text: The flanges are engraved with confessions. Some of them are still being added.

High Inquisitor Fairbanks.name: Crimson Inquisitor's Robe
High Inquisitor Fairbanks.flavor_text: Silk the colour of old wine. It never wrinkles, and it never forgives.

High Inquisitor Fairbanks.name: Sanctum Warplate Greaves
High Inquisitor Fairbanks.flavor_text: Worn by a man who believed every step was a sermon.

High Inquisitor Fairbanks.name: Blood-Etched Longsword
High Inquisitor Fairbanks.flavor_text: The blade is etched with names. Yours is not there. Yet.
